card.title: What a card is
card.text: A card is tied to a fixed amount in BTC and earns income at an annual rate while it's working.
points: Buy a card in the Shop
Start it in My cards — income accrues every minute
The dollar amount depends on the BTC rate

risks.title: Income and risks
risks.text: The rate is set by the service. It isn't guaranteed and may change.
points: Card value and income follow the BTC price
You may lose part or all of the funds
Use only money you can afford to lose

withdraw.title: How to withdraw
withdraw.text: Stop the card: after a 30-day pause, the purchase price and income go to your wallet.
points: Withdraw from the wallet in USDT (TRC20)
An administrator confirms each request manually
A card that hasn't been started can be sold for its purchase price
